name: model-routing-gate
description: Hook-covered model assignment and runtime model attestation for Codex subagents

interface.shortDescription: Enforce and attest hook-covered subagent assignments.
interface.longDescription: On proven hook-covered paths, blocks inherited or missing subagent assignments, correlates launch requests with runtime model evidence, and prevents inadmissible agent output from being collected. Host interception remains Unverified without runtime evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route subagents through the Model Routing Gate.
